name: HAKUTO-R Mission 2
intro: Konnichiwa! I'm Resilience. My name says it all: we never give up.
Second try for the HAKUTO-R team, now with a little rover called Tenacious.
Target: Mare Frigoris, the Sea of Cold, far in the north.
My laser rangefinder will tell me how high I am... I hope it's quick.
briefing: The laser is taking too long to measure the ground!
fact: Resilience crashed too, but the team keeps going: 'resilience' is a superpower in space.

alarm.title: Late Laser
alarm.alarm: LASER RANGEFINDER LATE — DESCENT TOO FAST
alarm.briefing: The laser measured the ground too late and we're falling too fast! In real life Resilience crashed. Choose a site and save it!
